==Background==
"'''Mind Brand'''" is an original song by MARETU. The song has many interpretations, some popular ones being a breakup and sexual assault. The meaning is up to the listener. This song has entered the [[Hall of Legend]] and exceeded 15 million views on YouTube. Hence, this is one of MARETU's most notable songs.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song was featured in the album ''[[コインロッカーベイビー (Coin Locker Baby) (album)|Coin Locker Baby]]''.

===Video games===
This song was featured in the video game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}'' (Virtual Singer version by Hatsune Miku; SEKAI version by 25-ji, Nightcord de. and Hatsune Miku).
